# RC42 — Move current line or selected lines

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/wscrpt`

Git: not a Git repository in this workspace; checkpoint identity is the source tree at this path plus the artifacts below.

## Change

- Added `Esc -` / `core.move-lines-up` / `Move Line/Selection Up`.
- Added `Esc =` / `core.move-lines-down` / `Move Line/Selection Down`.
- With no selection, the commands move the current logical line up or down and keep the cursor at the same relative column in the moved line.
- With a selection, the commands move the full affected logical-line range and keep the selection on the moved block.
- Top and bottom boundary attempts are safe no-ops with visible status.
- The operation is one dirty undoable edit when it changes text, and read-only IDE views refuse it.
- Compact help, action footer, command palette, keymap reference, README, and iPad QA now expose the route.
